labels: X is a matrix, W is a vector, XW is a vector

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is bold and large; 'BEST' is bold blue while the rest of the title is bold red. Equations use standard math notation with superscript T for transpose and Ŷ for predicted Y. 'Remember' labels are bold red. Body/equation text is black. The final W formula is emphasized with a green outline; the W in (X^T X)W is underlined.
animation_state: No build animation visible; all elements appear simultaneously on the slide.
recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to white. 2. Place the title at the top-left: 'Minimization of Loss function to obtain BEST model parameters'. Style 'Minimization of Loss function to obtain' and 'model parameters' in bold red; style 'BEST' in bold blue. 3. Add a yellow filled circle at the top-right containing the black numeral '5'. 4. Add a cream (#FFFFCC) rounded rectangle in the upper-left (~65% width). Inside, add three black-text equations: 'Loss = 1/2 (Y - Ŷ)^T (Y - Ŷ) = 1/2 (Y - XW)^T (Y - XW)', 'Loss = 1/2 [Y^T Y + (XW)^T (XW) - Y^T (XW) - (XW)^T Y]', and 'Loss = 1/2 [Y^T Y + (XW)^T (XW) - 2 (XW)^T Y]'. 5. Add a light-blue (#CCFFFF) rectangle in the upper-right. Put 'Remember' in bold red at the top, then 'X is a matrix, W is a vector,' on one line, 'XW is a vector' on the next, and 'X^T (XW) = (XW)^T X' below. 6. Add a light-pink (#FFCCCC) rectangle spanning the full width in the middle. Place '∂Loss/∂W = 0' on the left and 'Get Best W that minimizes the loss' on the right (same line). 7. Add a very-light-gray (#F0F0F0) rectangle in the lower-left. Add two equations: '∂Loss/∂W = 0 = 1/2 [(XW)^T (X) + (X)^T (XW) - 2 (X)^T Y]' and '∂Loss/∂W = 0 = 1/2 [2 X^T XW - 2 X^T Y] → (X^T X)W = X^T Y → W = (X^T X)^(-1) X^T Y'. Underline the 'W' in '(X^T X)W'. Draw a green outline rectangle around 'W = (X^T X)^(-1) X^T Y'. 8. Add a light-blue (#CCFFFF) rectangle in the lower-right. Put 'Remember' in bold red, then 'X^T (XW) = (XW)^T X' below it.
